items.title: The cohomological dimension of the maximal ideal of a local ring equals the dimension, and the top local cohomology of the ring is nonzero
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement computes the cohomological dimension of the maximal ideal of a Noetherian local ring as the dimension of the ring and shows that the top local cohomology of the ring does not vanish (author lemma at source lines 811-815, label lemma-cd-maximal). The proof (source lines 817-850) obtains the upper bound from the existence of an ideal of definition generated by d elements, observes that the three assertions of the statement are then equivalent, reduces to a complete local ring by the behaviour of cohomological dimension under completion, and concludes by identifying the top local cohomology with the Matlis dual of a degree of the normalized dualizing complex, which is nonzero (proof lines 838-849). The reduction to the complete case and the use of local duality are the content. H2.
